proposed.text: Which authority limit applies to an architect serving as Construction Manager under SPP 204-B?

options.text: The CM must not directly involve himself with contractor work in a way that assumes contractor liability
The CM must personally perform all contractor work
The CM may replace the architect-of-record's design concept at will
The CM has no authority limits under SPP 204-B

proposed.rationale: SPP 204-B limits the architect-CM from directly taking over contractor work and from imposing methods or designs that impair the schedule or design concept.
